'''Feena Ghel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] operating a repair shop in the mining town of [[Elesa]], on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]].

==Biography==
When [[Kaeline Ungasan]] began his project of the [[Ungasan Cross Country]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course, Ghel was trying to sell an [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] [[9000 Z001 landspeeder/Legends|9000 Z001 landspeeder]], customized to operate in the frozen conditions of Ando Prime.<ref name="G2" />
